subjects.description: Precision components ({parts}) on an assembly workbench in an electronics manufacturing line
subjects.appearance_details: Real production parts: anodized aluminium housings, stainless steel inserts, black and white plastic mouldings, small printed labels, fine surface texture and slight fingerprints
subjects.relationship: Parts ready to be picked by a robot and placed in a test rig
subjects.pose: Resting on the bench in stable positions
subjects.action: Static, nothing moves except the camera

background_setting: A clean but used ESD assembly area: light grey or blue anti-static mat on the bench, ESD-safe trays, a test rig and a monitor in the background, white walls and cable ducts

lighting.conditions: Even cool-white fluorescent and LED panel lighting
lighting.direction: Overhead and slightly from the front
lighting.shadows: Soft, low-contrast shadows under the parts

aesthetics.composition: Functional top-down-ish view with every part visible
aesthetics.color_scheme: Light greys, blue mat, metal and black plastic

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow, smooth handheld-free camera move around the bench, like an industrial camera on a slowly moving robot arm
cinematography.framing: Close to medium shot of the bench top with all parts in frame
cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down at the bench
cinematography.depth_of_field: Deep focus, all parts sharp as with a machine-vision camera
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Machine-vision lens, natural perspective, slight vignetting

style_medium: Raw footage from a real industrial camera, unedited, no color grading
artistic_style: Photorealistic, authentic real-world recording: realistic materials, faint sensor noise, accurate colors
context: Footage from a robot cell that loads a test rig in a Brainport high-tech SME
